name: Node Delete Redirect
description: Enables user of the right permission to define redirection path on node deletion.
project_description: Node Delete Redirect is a lightweight module that lets an administrator configure, per content type, the internal path a user is sent to after deleting a node. By default Drupal returns the user to the front page after a node delete; with this module you can, for example, send the user to the news listing after deleting a news article and to a different landing page for other bundles. Redirect targets are set on a single settings form (Configuration > Content authoring > Node delete redirect) and are validated as internal Drupal paths at save time. An optional alpha language-support option prefixes the redirect with the current language code so multilingual sites land on the language-appropriate version of the target path.
